title: A Learnable Google Car - Camera Generations

cards.note: • Gen 1 has a very bad camera quality and is very rare.

• Gen 2 can be recognized by the big circular car blur and the halo-like colour distortion in the sky.
  • Quality is still not very good.

• Gen 3 has improved quality and resolution over gen 2.
  • Colors are more grey-ish and less colorful than in gen 4.
• Gen 4 has the highest quality and the brightest colors.

The camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:

  • The car blur is significantly bigger.
  • Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖

There are 3 main countries with lowcam:

  • Switzerland, Japan, Sri Lanka (Gen 4 only)

NOTE: Lowcam also exists in Liechtenstein

Features a low-quality camera that can typically be recognised by the brownish colours and often, but not always, by a large circular blur covering the Street View car.

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖

These are the main countries with shitcam:

  • India, Sri Lanka, Cambodia
  • Finland, Ecuador, Nigeria

NOTE: Shitcam can also exist in Bangladesh, Lebanon, Sao Tome & Principe, Alaska
